requirement: The platform shall preserve every ingested artifact as immutable exact source bytes with stable content identity and append-only versions.
The platform shall reject externally derived material claims unless their provenance can recover the source artifact version and location.
The platform shall retain conflicting supported claims and materialize their disagreement without overwriting either claim.
The platform shall preserve original assertions when a human correction creates a replacement assertion and shall identify affected rule evaluations.
The core ingestion and evidence workflow shall operate deterministically without an AI provider.
Optional reasoning shall enforce provider locality policy and reject malformed provider output before it reaches deterministic decision logic.
Rule evaluations shall record exact versioned definitions and inputs so identical verified inputs reproduce the same result.
Rule-created obligations deadlines and tasks shall retain the evaluation and evidence chain that caused their creation.
Case-specific answers shall use explicit epistemic modes and cite only stored case evidence without supplying missing world knowledge.
The versioned HTTP API and command line interface shall invoke the same application service boundaries.
Persistence schema evolution shall be ordered checksummed repeatable and reject mutation of applied migrations.
Runtime configuration and diagnostics shall default to bounded local operation and shall not disclose source content in failure events.
The core shall operate without a vertical-domain package and shall accept domain behavior only through the extension contract.
Material numeric monetary temporal and epistemic values shall retain exactness and represent uncertainty explicitly.
Untrusted identifiers filenames and artifact sizes shall be validated before they reach storage boundaries.
The project shall maintain controlled requirements bidirectional implementation traces verification references configuration items and problem reports.
The artifact store shall address bytes by SHA-256 write atomically and reverify existing or retrieved bytes against their digest.
The database shall prevent update or deletion of artifact versions claims evidence reviews rule versions and evaluations.
Extracted fields shall retain their original representation and a field span or row and column source location.
Construction of an externally derived material claim shall fail when its provenance identifier is absent.
A malformed reasoning response shall create a content-minimized failure record and shall not expose the raw response.
A query with no supported stored assertion shall return unknown with no citations.
A rule evaluation shall persist deterministic hashes of its definition and canonical input snapshot.
The API shall serve a checked-in valid OpenAPI document describing the implemented versioned core routes.
Continuous integration shall validate assurance data formatting static analysis tests and migrations using controlled tool versions.
All Rust workspace crates shall forbid unsafe code and compile with warnings denied during static analysis.
